name: Ranger Firearms (Combat Style) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Ranger Firearms (Combat Style) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Polearm (Combat Style)", "Spear (Combat Style)" but are not part of the Ranger Firearms (Combat Style) entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Polearm (Combat Style)

Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Combat Reflexes, Polearm Expertise, and Power Attack.

At 6th level, he adds Great Cleave, Improved Cleaving Finish, Lunge, and Whirlwind Attack to the list.

At 10th level, he adds and Pin Down and Strike Back and to the list.

From d20pfsrd.com: Spear (Combat Style)

Spear Combat Style (Ex)

If the ranger selects spear style, he can choose from the following list whenever he gains a combat style feat: Charging Hurler, Distance Thrower, Power Attack, Powerful Throwing, and Two-Handed Thrower.

At 6th level, he adds Impaling Critical, Improved Charging Hurler, and Precise Shot to the list.

At 10th level, he adds Impact Critical Shot and Improved Impaling Critical to the list.
